explanations.prediction: Too little Kp makes the arm react too slow and settle with a large error. Too little Kd causes overshoot and oscillation because there  isn't enough damping to control it.
explanations.tuning_analysis: I increased Kp to make both joints respond strongly to the targets and used Kd to reduce overshoot and oscillation. The evidence of improvement was that the arm successfully nailed all 3 poses and settled in more smoothly. Gravity compensation helped the shoulder handle the downward force from the arm, making it easier to hold the target position.
